name: yahoo-search-mcp
description: Search Yahoo! JAPAN — web, images, video, news, real-time X posts and Chiebukuro Q&A. Zero-config, no API key, no login.
long_description:
Yahoo! JAPAN Search MCP gives an AI agent access to every major Yahoo! JAPAN search vertical. Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content — local shops, government sites, community Q&A, domestic news — far more deeply than general-purpose engines, which makes this the right tool for any question about Japan.

Results are read from the server-rendered payload the public search pages already ship to browsers. There is no API key to obtain, no account to create and no configuration file to edit: download, run, done.

## Verticals
- **ウェブ検索** — general web search, with paging, a last-updated filter and a site: restriction
- **画像検索** — images with source page, original and Yahoo-cached URLs, and pixel dimensions
- **動画検索** — videos across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Niconico and others
- **ニュース検索** — Japanese news with publisher, publish time and category
- **リアルタイム検索** — live X (Twitter) posts, sortable by recency or popularity
- **知恵袋検索** — Japan's largest community Q&A site
- **サジェスト** — autocomplete keywords, to learn how Japanese users phrase a topic
